items.title: China-Linked Hackers Exploit VMware ESXi Zero-Days to Escape Virtual Machines
items.description: Chinese-speaking threat actors are suspected to have leveraged a compromised SonicWall VPN appliance as an initial access vector to deploy a VMware ESXi exploit that may have been developed as far back as February 2024. items.title: ZDI-CAN-28710: FontForge
items.description: A CVSS score 7.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H severity vulnerability discovered by 'Brandon Evans of Trend Zero Day Initiative' was reported to the affected vendor on: 2026-01-09, 0 days ago. The vendor is given until 2026-05-09 to publish a fix or workaround. Once the vendor has created and tested a patch we will coordinate the release of a public advisory.
